description: Act on one in-flight durable run: `pause`, `resume`, `terminate` (stops it where it is; completed steps are not undone), or `send_event` to deliver an event to a run parked on a wait or approval, resuming it. For send_event, read get_run first and use one of its `awaitingEvents` as `eventType`: Cloudflare accepts any type, so a wrong one silently does nothing. To run a workflow again from the start, use run_workflow; replaying from a step is not offered because it would repeat effects that already happened.

eventType.description: Required for send_event: one of the run's awaitingEvents, exactly.

payload.description: send_event only: JSON delivered to the waiting node.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: control_run
title: Control run
